cause: Windows PowerShell converted a null File.Replace backup-name argument to an invalid empty path; both the initial replacement and automatic restore invocation refused before replacing active bytes.
impact: Production service was stopped until the retained old executable was explicitly restarted; the initial attempt did not replace active executable bytes.
recovery: Original executable hash verified, service restarted, sync/async valid/invalid and wrong-pin controls passed.
correction: Explicit exclusive backup paths for atomic replacement and rollback; actual NTFS replacement/rollback probe passed before retry.
finalOutcome: Exact reviewed rc.11 executable deployed; live controls, automatic startup after actual reboot, preserved configuration/DLLs/certificates/runtime verified.
